entities.summary: Prince Thammathibet Chaiyachet Suriyawong, also titled Prince Senaphithak and known poetically as Prince Narathibet, or more commonly Prince Kung, served as Viceroy of the Ayutthaya Kingdom from 1741 to 1755.
